$comment: The result of accept, in actionFinished. A refusal as `untrusted` says the host did not try the accept, because an edit by someone without write access changed the text it reads.

baseFailure.$comment: For a refusal as `checkFailed`: the work item about a failure the base branch has, when every required check that failed fails as it does there, as the host compares them; null or left out otherwise. The fix round waits for that failure to end rather than fix it again.
